steps.text: Use the pot of flour on the cow pen gate.
Return to Gordon and talk to him.
Use the knife on the soft clay then talk to Gordon.
Use the bear fur on the clay head then talk to Gordon.
Use the red dye on the fur head then talk to Gordon.
Build the Mounted Head Space inside the farmhouse.
Talk to Gordon south of the Farming Guild.
Talk to Mary inside the main building, west of Gordon.
Climb up the nearby house's staircase.
Take the nearby pot of flour, or fill a pot with the barrel of flour in the south west room.
Go back downstairs.
Enter the Kebos Lowlands mine just west of the bridge and kill the Headless Beast (level 82).
Kill the headless beast. You can safespot it from the south west corner of the pond in the cave.
Leave the cave.
Talk with Gordon.
Talk with Gordon.
Talk with Gordon.
Talk to Mary inside the house.
Take the pickaxe in the mine.
Mine some clay.
Take the knife near Mary.
Take the bucket in the house.
Fill the bucket on the sink.
Use the bucket of water on the clay.
Take the needle.
Take the thread.
Use the bear fur on the clay head then talk to Gordon.
Get some red dye from the shelves in the farm house.
Take the planks outside the monster's cave.
Take the saw in the building north of the farmhouse.
Take the hammer east of the farmhouse.
Take some nails from the farm's workbench.
Return to Gordon to finish the quest.
